description.value:
Rank 1 Melee Technique

  • Ki Cost: Special
  • Casting Time: 1 Reaction, which you take when a creature targets you with a Melee Attack Roll or Melee/Melee Weapon Technique.
  • Range: Melee
  • Chargeable?: No
  • Duration: Until the start of your next turn

An expertly done boxer's counter. For the duration, each time a Melee Attack Roll or Melee/Melee Weapon Technique that targets you, you can spend 8 Ki. When you do, you attempt to duck and weave granting yourself +2 to your AC against the triggering attack and then immediately make one Unarmed Strike in response. Each time you Master this Technique you may reduce the Ki Cost per punch by 1 or increase the AC bonus by 1 each time.
